title: Consolidate Platform K billing onto Platform S's Stripe integration (one company, one Stripe)
description:
## Decision (Kam, 2026-05-21)

Platform K will use the **same Stripe integration as Platform S** — same company, so one Stripe account/integration, not two. Platform K should **not** maintain its own separate Stripe.

## Current state

* **Platform S** (`platform-s-main`, [ASP.NET](<http://ASP.NET>) Core) has a mature **subscription** Stripe integration: `Services/Stripe/StripeSubscriptionClient.cs`, `Controllers/StripeController.cs` + `StripeProductController.cs`, `Services/Idv/StripeIdvService.cs` (Stripe Identity). Hosted-checkout subscriptions (monthly/yearly; sgd/gbp/usd/eur), webhook `/stripe/webhook` (checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.deleted, invoice.payment_failed). Keys in `StripeCredentialsManager.cs` / appsettings.
* **Platform K** has its own *separate* billing service (`Blockchain/Dev/services/billing`, Node, Stripe test mode) doing credits/bundles for certifications — a duplicate Stripe integration.

## Priority / why not urgent

Payments are **not on Platform K's critical path** (core = Cardano cert: Issue → Verify → Revoke), so this doesn't block stable/testable. Medium. The billing-500-on-bad-input papercut is **dropped** — no point hardening a service that's being consolidated away.

## Action

1. @stuart.jamieson **— please provide the Stripe integration details, or point to where they live:** the company Stripe account/keys (test + live), the subscription/product model, and how Platform K should hook in (share Platform S's billing surface, call its API, or have Platform S own the subscription that covers K usage).
2. Based on that: either **remove/disable** Platform K's `services/billing` (if K stays payment-free) or **wire it to the shared integration**. Also decide whether to keep Platform K billing deployed on dev meanwhile (relates to [KS-96](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-96/8-dev-services-return-502-unreachable)).

**Open question for the team:** is Platform S the single billing surface for the company, with Platform K payment-free (or deferring to the S subscription)?

Filed 2026-05-21.

nodes.body:
It occured to me this morning, what happens if someone is using the api for a third party app. Ie this is the same model as platform s handling the billing but now we have a third party required to bill.

Some options perhaps …

Track usage metrics in k and invoice at the end of the month

Have an app subscription that stops if usage exceeds agreement … ie like Claude 

In advance sub with over spend agreements, again managed by k

**Decision (Kam, 2026-06-03): all billing goes through Platform S for now — Platform K billing work is paused.** This ticket stays as the tracking item for the consolidation direction (one company, one Stripe, on Platform S), which is exactly the intent here. No new Platform K billing/Stripe feature work until the consolidation is scoped.

The one in-flight Platform K billing change, KS-157 (admin-auth + audit on `/webhooks/replay`), is being merged regardless — it only closes a live unprotected-endpoint hole on the currently-deployed billing service; it doesn't extend PK billing. After that, PK billing is frozen pending this consolidation.

**Decided at the 2026-05-25 technical catch-up (Stuart + Kam) — ALIGNED:** billing consolidates onto **Platform S**. S is the user/org interface and the **single billing route**; **K is a cost center** (no client-facing billing on K). Tokenised models where clients interact directly with K are a **medium-term** possibility but **deferred** — single billing point via S is the standard for the current phase.

Implementation (consolidate Platform K billing onto Platform S's Stripe) stays with Stuart. Transcript: §Billing Model and S/K Interaction ~00:43–00:46.
